sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Garage Locations
sources.note: Read Nov 24, 2026 via ?p=370534 (published Nov 18, modified Nov 22 20:32 UTC). Trusted. 13 garages: 8 bought in Vice City Real Estate after Daily Driver, 4 story rewards, 1 collectible reward (Southside Storage, 1010 Murals). Names, prices, parking spots, unlock missions. No areas. Page says 18 slots max (16 garages + 2 personal vehicles), but its own per-garage numbers add up to 17, so no total is shown. Spells 'Vela Rota Driver Garage'; every other source says Drive.

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Garage Locations (update)
sources.note: Read Nov 26, 2026 (modified Nov 26 00:24 UTC). Trusted. Now 14 garages: adds #14 Domestic Timbers, 1 spot, reward for finishing Randy's questline (Wish List > Dale Mamba > Mansion Thrax > Delivery Day), given with the Tempesta. No area on this page; Balsero from PowerPyx Collect the Tempesta (marked garage in Balsero). Page now says 20 slots = 18 from garages + 2 personal vehicles, which matches its per-garage spots (8 + 1 + 2 + 2 + 3 + 1 + 1 = 18).

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 Collect the Tempesta Walkthrough
sources.note: Read Nov 26, 2026 (published 00:26 UTC). Trusted. After Delivery Day Randy texts about an extra reward; marked garage in Balsero; Raul's Tempesta from Meet the Heders; sell ~$27,150 (good condition) or register $11,600; unlocks Domestic Timbers, 1 spot.

items.name: Southside Storage
items.note: Locked with a keypad: the code is **1010**. The 1010 Cheetah is parked inside; register it to keep it, or sell it.

items.name: Domestic Timbers
items.note: Randy leaves Raul's old **Pegassi Tempesta** in it for you. Sell the car for about $27,150 or register it for $11,600; the garage is yours either way.

items.name: Paradise Garage
items.note: Comes with the '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy, a weapon locker and a stash for fencing.

items.name: Shore Court Garage
items.note: The pre-order pack for anything bought before November 20. Comes with the '55 Vapid Stanier, a weapon locker and a stash for fencing.
